# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite bindings and async pixel reads alongside the Skia m152 engine update. It also adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package, native symbols for Apple platforms, Nano Server font support, and multiple lifecycle and performance fixes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m152 with subsequent upstream servicing and stability fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings** — Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, enabling applications to adopt the newer rendering architecture. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback** — SKImage and SKSurface now provide backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs for non-blocking pixel retrieval. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel source lifetimes corrected** — Keeps pixel sources alive for SKPixmap subset and With operations, and releases raster allocations when SKImage creation fails. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Region and stream lifetime fixes** — Roots regions used by span iterators and disposes the non-memory-backed stream path used to create HarfBuzz blobs. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Lower allocation overhead** — Avoids an unnecessary SKData save copy, feature-array copying during HarfBuzz shaping, and avoidable string and uniform lookup allocations. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752))
- **Uniform buffer replacement cleanup** — SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset now disposes its previous uniform buffer before replacing it. ([#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Expanded native platform packages** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, produces Apple native symbol packages, and uses FreeType for Nano Server font support. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Improves HarfBuzz shaping performance by avoiding a defensive feature-array copy, fixes non-memory stream cleanup, and reduces tag formatting allocations.
